note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Guides are written in our own words for this entry and cite their sources. 7 trophies are marked unconfirmed: the community still disagrees on their exact trigger. Exactly 1 trophy is missable.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are in your collection. There is no separate task — follow the six roadmap stages in order and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its story missions in order. Story trophies cannot be missed — just keep following the main missions.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its story missions in order. Like every chapter trophy, it is unmissable.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its story missions in order. The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its story missions in order. The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. The gold pops as the end credits roll — one of only two gold trophies on the list.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete it to roll the credits

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the main story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks as part of the main story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks as part of the main story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It unlocks as part of the main story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks as part of the main story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks as part of the main story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every mission, activity, collectible and challenge the game counts. Open the in-game stats page to see exactly what is still missing, then clear it stage by stage.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Check the stats page until it reads 100%

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near misses and air time all count. Chain them on the highways around Vice City and the counter climbs fast.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Find a fast car or bike

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade, bowling, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough — you do not need to win any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Pick a steady weapon, aim for headshots, and replay any challenge until the gold score lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's corners first, then win them one by one.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street, off-road, boat or air — as long as each win is a different event.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the line tension, reel in when it slackens, and do not let the fish snap the line.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Start a fishing challenge against Cal
Land the catch before he does

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand to its final mission, then complete it. Stranger strands appear as '?' on the map.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Play his missions to the last one

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand to its final mission, then complete it. Stranger strands appear as '?' on the map.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Play his missions to the last one

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand to its final mission, then complete it. Stranger strands appear as '?' on the map.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Play his missions to the last one

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as '?' on the map — follow each strand to its end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand to its final mission, then complete it. Stranger strands appear as '?' on the map.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Play his missions to the last one

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission, then complete it. Stranger strands appear as '?' on the map.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Play his missions to the last one

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are quiet scenic points — beaches, hilltops and piers. Do them as you explore, because some spots can lock after story progress. This is the only missable trophy on the list: if you finish the story first, you may have to start over.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Find a meditation spot — look for the calm scenic markers
Do them before the story moves on — do not leave them for post-game

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand, track the animal to its territory, and take the shot cleanly.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards hide in shops, drawers and mission rewards across Leonida — check every set's checklist and trade your duplicates.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The app marks photo spots across the state — snap each one and the counter climbs.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open WAiNK It at a marked spot

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more — the challenges menu shows your progress toward 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, swap cars, and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Reach 4 stars, then escape the heat

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Move fast between shops and keep the heat on — do not let the stars drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Rob 3 shops in a row, keeping the wanted level

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new car, bike, boat or plane you drive for the first time counts — variety is the fastest route to 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive every new vehicle you see

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group the enemies first, trigger focus, and chain the kills before the meter runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Trigger Combat Focus and down them all

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — reports point to grabbing a plane or slipping out through a restricted exit. Community details still differ, so treat the exact method as provisional.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Reports suggest taking one on directly, but the exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the community.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway car first — the escape counts as much as the vault.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush it on a quiet road, crack it open, then lose the cops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive the back roads and the coastline until every area name appears.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One hit per gang is enough — learn each gang's turf first.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and take in the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Order a cocktail with the view

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom in a car

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throws.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — reports link it to a big shared moment with your partner, but the exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the community.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PSN tracks a count toward 500. Keep making story and world choices; the exact count is still being confirmed by the community.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices in story and free roam

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — reports point to succeeding right after a failed attempt. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an attempt, then succeed on the retry

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida hides odd sights for the curious. Community reports differ on which sight counts, so this one is provisional.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — knock a pedestrian down from a moving vehicle with a melee hit. The exact method is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists — pass them through contacts until $250,000 is clean.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, cars, weapons and food all count — the total adds up across every shop in Leonida.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale across the state — buy every one to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any vehicle you own can be registered — snap and register 10 of them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
